subject: Pipeline spring-clean: SKU / Amount / Probability triage
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Elaine Shaw <elaine.shaw@oriontech.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline spring-clean: SKU / Amount / Probability triage

Team —

Quick sync to get the Orion Tech close into a defensible forecast for the finance review next week. I pulled the Q3 snapshot and there are three items we need to lock down on every mid- and late-stage deal:

• Amount: confirm ARR number and any pending discounts; prefer committed amount in HubSpot.
• Product/SKU: map the line items to the standardized SKU table in the attached workbook. Avoid free-form descriptions.
• Probability & Next Step: set the stage and next milestone (PO, legal review, pilot start) and update probability to reflect that milestone.

I attached the snapshot and the current SKU map (forecast_snapshot_Q3.csv, sku_mapping_v2.xlsx). Action plan:
- Marissa: run SKU mapping pass and return mismatches by EOD Wed (07/07).
- Ben: validate amounts for top 10 pipeline deals including OR-4721 (Orion Tech) and call out any credit/discount asks.
- Karthik: update probability model inputs where champion / procurement are stalled; flag those deals for leadership review.
- Lauren: once the above are done, lock records in HubSpot and export a cleaned CSV to finance.

Elaine — looping you in so procurement has visibility. If Orion has any outstanding PO timing or legal blockers, please let us know before Thursday.

Goal: have the cleaned feed ready for the 07/08 finance checkpoint. If we miss that, the number will remain an estimate.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: forecast_snapshot_Q3.csv (CSV, 420KB)
Attachment: sku_mapping_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 1.2MB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Elaine Shaw <elaine.shaw@oriontech.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline spring-clean: SKU / Amount / Probability triage

Thanks Jordan — starting the SKU pass now. Early observations after a quick scan:

• OR-4721 (Orion Tech): two line items use free-text descriptions ("AI infra credits" / "discount bundle") instead of SKUs; likely maps to SKU-RED-STD and SKU-RED-PRM but needs sales confirmation.
• Several EMEA deals were tagged with legacy SKUs (pre-quantization). I'll normalize to the v2 codes.
• I found ~18 records with blank unit_price or quantity fields — flagging those for Ben to confirm amounts.

Plan: I will generate a mismatch report and a proposed SKU map (sheet: proposed_mappings) and upload to the Drive link by 07/07 17:00 PT. If anyone wants ownership of a specific account row, reply and I'll assign.

Marissa
Sr. Revenue Operations Analyst
Attachment: sku_mapping_v2_review.xlsx (XLSX, 200KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Elaine Shaw <elaine.shaw@oriontech.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline spring-clean: SKU / Amount / Probability triage

I'll take OR-4721 and OR-4699 off the top 10 list. Quick notes after looking at the HubSpot records:

• OR-4721: Current ARR shows $345,000 but there's a pending 10% promotional concession requested by the buyer; legal has a draft SOW but procurement hasn't committed to a PO date. Recommend we tentatively set Amount = $310,500 (showing discount) and Prob = 60% until PO date confirmed.
• OR-4699: Amount correct, but next step is "Legal review" — update probability to 45% per stage guidance.

I'll reach out to the Orion champion (Elaine) offline to confirm the concession timing and push for a hard PO date. Will post updates in the Drive sheet when I have confirmation.

—Ben
Enterprise AE
Attachment: none

From: Elaine Shaw <elaine.shaw@oriontech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@oriontech.com
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline spring-clean: SKU / Amount / Probability triage

Jordan / team — thanks for the heads up and for taking the lead. Quick status from procurement/legal side:

• The 10% promotional concession is under internal review; procurement is evaluating whether it needs approval from finance. I expect a decision by Friday 07/09.
• PO timing: procurement can issue a PO as soon as legal signs off; they are targeting 07/15 but I will try to accelerate.
• SKU mapping: procurement prefers explicit SKU lines for invoicing. I can confirm SKU-RED-PRM for the premium credits item; the other line is a services bundle that needs clarification from your side.

If you can lock Amount in HubSpot to show the concession (Ben's suggested $310,500) for forecast purposes, we are okay with that as long as the invoice reflects the final confirmed numbers later.

Elaine Shaw
Senior Procurement Manager
Orion Tech
Attachment: procurement_terms_summary.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
